finalists.label: Sarcoidosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific findings including new left bundle branch block, prolonged QTc, and mid-myocardial late gadolinium enhancement in the basal anteroseptal wall.

finalists.label: Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: It is supported by multiple findings such as LVEF of 42% with a moderate-size area of inferior wall ischaemia and scar, and mid-myocardial late gadolinium enhancement in the basal anteroseptal wall without any against evidence.

finalists.label: Chagas Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: It is proposed with specific findings like prolonged QTc and LVEF of 45–50% with no regional wall motion abnormalities, and no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: Sarcoidosis is chosen due to its specific findings including new left bundle branch block, prolonged QTc, and mid-myocardial late gadolinium enhancement in the basal anteroseptal wall, which are more decisive than the findings supporting Cardiomyopathy.
